Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its
scales together and roars. Its sharp claws
shred the opposition.
details.descriptionKr:
비늘을 부딪쳐 우렁찬 소리를
낸 후 상대에게 덤벼들어
날카로운 손톱으로 갈기갈기 찢는다.
details.descriptionJp:
ウロコを　うちならし　おたけびを
あげてから　あいてに　いどみかかり
するどい　ツメで　ずたずたに　する。

details.descriptionEn:
Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is
devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and
can be described as nature incarnate.
details.descriptionKr:
수호신으로 불리지만 천진난만하면서
잔혹한 성질도 겸비한
자연의 화신이라 할 수 있는 존재다.
details.descriptionJp:
まもりがみと　よばれるが　むじゃきで
ざんこくな　せいしつも　あわせもつ
しぜんのけしんと　いえる　そんざい。

details.descriptionEn:
The lightning-wielding guardian deity of
Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity
and appears before people from time to time.
details.descriptionKr:
번개를 조종하는 멜레멜레의
수호신. 호기심이 왕성해서
가끔 사람들 앞에 나타난다.
details.descriptionJp:
かみなりを　あやつる　メレメレの
まもりがみ。　こうきしんおうせいで
ときおり　ひとまえに　あらわれる。

details.descriptionEn:
Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors
wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
details.descriptionKr:
짜랑고우거의 비늘로 만든
갑옷을 두른 고대의 전사가
유적에 그려져 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
ジャラランガの　ウロコで　つくった
ヨロイを　みに　まとった　こだいの
せんしが　いせきに　えがかれている。

details.descriptionEn:
It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others
know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts.
This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.
details.descriptionKr:
꼬리로 소리를 내어 위치를 알림으로써
불필요한 싸움을 피한다. 초목을
조종하는 울라울라의 수호신.
details.descriptionJp:
シッポを　ならし　いばしょを　つたえ
むだなあらそいを　さける。　くさきを
あやつる　ウラウラの　まもりがみ。

details.descriptionEn:
Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible
calamities sometimes befall those who
recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
details.descriptionKr:
수호신으로 불리지만 무턱대고
다가오는 상대에게는 무서운
재앙을 가져다주는 일도 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
まもりがみと　よばれるが　むやみに
ちかづく　あいてには　おそろしい
わざわいを　もたらすこともある。

details.descriptionEn:
Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious,
often placing itself in danger. If things start to
look dicey, it teleports away.
details.descriptionKr:
경계심이 없고 호기심이 왕성해
위험한 상황에 맞닥뜨리는 경우가 많다.
위기에 처하면 워프해서 도망친다.
details.descriptionJp:
むけいかいで　こうきしんが　つよく
あぶない　めに　あうことも　おおい。
ピンチになると　ワープで　にげる。

details.descriptionEn:
It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate,
frantically building up energy within its core as
preparation for evolution.
details.descriptionKr:
대기의 티끌을 굉장한 기세로
빨아들여 진화 에너지를
코어에서 열심히 만들고 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
たいきの　チリを　すごい　いきおいで
すいこみ　しんかの　エネルギーを
コアで　けんめいに　つくっている。

details.descriptionEn:
Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That
Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light
radiates boundlessly from it.
details.descriptionKr:
태양을 삼키는 짐승이라고
불렸다. 굉장한 양의
빛 에너지를 방출한다.
details.descriptionJp:
たいようを　くらいし　けもの　と
かつて　よばれた。　むじんぞうの
ひかりエネルギーを　ほうしゅつする。

details.descriptionEn:
It steals the light from its surroundings and then
becomes the full moon, showering its own light
across the night sky.
details.descriptionKr:
주위의 빛을 모두 빼앗아
자신 스스로 만월의 모습이 되어
밤하늘에 빛을 발산한다.
details.descriptionJp:
しゅういの　ひかりを　すべて　うばい
みずからは　まんげつの　すがたとなり
やみよに　ひかりを　はなつ。

details.descriptionEn:
It appeared in this world from an Ultra
Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite
that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
details.descriptionKr:
울트라홀을 통해 이 세계에
나타났다. 포켓몬이나 인간에게
기생해서 사는 듯하다.
details.descriptionJp:
ウルトラホールから　このせかいに
あらわれた。　ポケモンや　にんげんに
きせいして　いきているようだ。

details.descriptionEn:
Buzzwole goes around showing off its
abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind
of Ultra Beast.
details.descriptionKr:
이상할 정도로 팽창하는
근육을 자랑한다.
울트라비스트의 일종.
details.descriptionJp:
いじょうな　までに　ぼうちょうする
きんにくを　みせつけてきた。
ウルトラビーストの　いっしゅ。

details.descriptionEn:
Although it’s alien to this world and a danger
here, it’s apparently a common organism in the
world where it normally lives.
details.descriptionKr:
이 세계와는 성질이 다르고
위험하지만 원래 살던 세계에서는
흔히 볼 수 있는 생물인 듯하다.
details.descriptionJp:
このせかいでは　いしつで　きけんだが
ほんらい　すんでいる　せかいでは
ふつうに　みかける　せいぶつらしい。

details.descriptionEn:
They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of
them stand unmoving, like trees, with their
arms and legs stuck into the ground.
details.descriptionKr:
울트라비스트라고 불린다.
나무처럼 땅에 손발을 꽂고
움직이지 않는 것도 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
ウルトラビーストと　よばれる。
じゅもくのように　じめんに　てあしを
さしたまま　うごかないもの　もいる。

details.descriptionEn:
Although it’s alien to this world and a danger
here, it’s apparently a common organism in the
world where it normally lives.
details.descriptionKr:
이 세계와는 성질이 다르고
위험하지만 원래 살던 세계에서는
흔히 볼 수 있는 생물인 듯하다.
details.descriptionJp:
このせかいでは　いしつで　きけんだが
ほんらい　すんでいる　せかいでは
ふつうに　みかける　せいぶつらしい。

details.descriptionEn:
Although it’s alien to this world and a danger
here, it’s apparently a common organism in the
world where it normally lives.
details.descriptionKr:
이 세계와는 성질이 다르고
위험하지만 원래 살던 세계에서는
흔히 볼 수 있는 생물인 듯하다.
details.descriptionJp:
このせかいでは　いしつで　きけんだが
ほんらい　すんでいる　せかいでは
ふつうに　みかける　せいぶつらしい。

details.descriptionEn:
An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be
constantly hungry—it is certainly always
devouring something.
details.descriptionKr:
UB라고 불리는 미지의 생명체.
늘 배가 고픈 상태인 것인지
계속해서 무언가를 먹고 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
ＵＢと　よばれる　みちの　せいめい。
つねに　はらを　すかせているのか
ずっと　なにかを　くらっている。

details.descriptionEn:
It needs light to survive, and it goes on a
rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will
cut anything to pieces.
details.descriptionKr:
살기 위해 빛을 찾아 날뛰며
돌아다닌다. 레이저 광선을 쏘아
온갖 것을 산산조각 낸다.
details.descriptionJp:
いきるために　ひかりを　もとめて
あばれまわる。　レーザーこうせんを
はなち　あらゆるものを　きりきざむ。

details.descriptionEn:
Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist,
the part called the Soul-Heart is the
actual life-form.
details.descriptionKr:
약 500년 전 과학자에 의해
만들어졌다. 소울하트라고
불리는 파츠가 본체다.
details.descriptionJp:
およそ　５００ねんまえ　かがくしゃに
よって　つくられた。　ソウルハートと
よばれる　パーツが　ほんたいなのだ。

details.descriptionEn:
This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow,
so it went undiscovered for a long time.
details.descriptionKr:
모든 그림자 안에 숨어들 수 있는
능력을 갖고 있어 오랫동안
누구에게도 발견되지 않았다.
details.descriptionJp:
あらゆる　かげの　なかに　もぐりこむ
のうりょくを　もっているため　ながい
あいだ　だれにも　みつからなかった。

details.descriptionEn:
An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it
cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with
poison from the needles on its head.
details.descriptionKr:
다른 세계에 사는 울트라비스트.
머리의 독침에서 나온 독액을
상대에게 끼얹고 깔깔 웃는다.
details.descriptionJp:
いせかいに　すむ　ウルトラビースト。
あたまの　どくばりから　どくえきを
あいてに　かけて　ケラケラ　わらう。

details.descriptionEn:
One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing,
venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid
is also immensely adhesive.
details.descriptionKr:
울트라비스트의 일종.
독침에서 점도가 높고
빛나는 독액을 발사한다.
details.descriptionJp:
ウルトラビーストの　いっしゅ。
どくばりから　ねんどが　たかく
ひかる　どくえきを　はっしゃする。

details.descriptionEn:
When stone walls started moving and attacking,
the brute’s true identity was this mysterious
life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
details.descriptionKr:
UB 같은 수수께끼의 생명체.
갑자기 움직이기 시작해서 덮쳐온
돌담의 정체는 이 녀석이다.
details.descriptionJp:
ＵＢらしき　なぞの　せいめいたい。
とつぜん　うごきだして　おそってきた
いしがきの　しょうたいは　こいつだ。

details.descriptionEn:
A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it
causes explosions, then takes advantage of
opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.
details.descriptionKr:
울트라홀에서 나타난 UB.
폭발로 상대를 놀라게 하고
그 틈에 생기를 빼앗는다.
details.descriptionJp:
ウルトラホールから　あらわれたＵＢ。
ばくはつで　あいてを　おどろかし
そのすきに　せいきを　うばっていた。

details.descriptionEn:
Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs.
Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and
thunder echoes.
details.descriptionKr:
손발의 볼록살에서 전기를 내보낸다.
제라오라가 달려나가면 번개가
치고 우렛소리가 울려 퍼진다.
details.descriptionJp:
てあしの　にくきゅうから　ほうでん。
ゼラオラが　かけぬけると　イナズマが
ひかり　らいめいが　とどろく。

details.descriptionEn:
They live as a group, but when the time comes,
one strong Meltan will absorb all the others
and evolve.
details.descriptionKr:
무리 지어 생활하지만
때가 되면 1마리의 강한 멜탄이
동료들을 흡수해 진화한다.
details.descriptionJp:
むれになって　せいかつするが　ときが
くると　１ぴきの　つよい　メルタンが
なかまたちを　とりこみ　しんかする。

details.descriptionEn:
Centrifugal force is behind the punches of
Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said
to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.
details.descriptionKr:
원심력으로 힘을 더해서
날리는 묵직한 너트 펀치는
포켓몬 중 최강이라고 전해진다.
details.descriptionJp:
えんしんりょくで　はずみを　つけて
くりだす　おもい　ナットの　パンチは
ポケモン　さいきょうと　いわれる。

details.descriptionEn:
It attacks with rapid beats of its stick.
As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets
more and more pumped.
details.descriptionKr:
스틱으로 연타하여 공격한다.
굉장한 속도로 치다 보면
점점 텐션이 올라간다.
details.descriptionJp:
スティックの　れんだで　こうげき。
すごい　スピードで　たたくうちに
どんどん　テンションが　あがるのだ。

details.descriptionEn:
When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it
gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even
notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.
details.descriptionKr:
격렬한 비트를 내는데
열중한 나머지 싸움에서
상대가 기절해도 모른다.
details.descriptionJp:
はげしい　ビートを　きざむことに
むちゅうになる　あまり　たたかいで
あいてが　きぜつしても　きづかない。

details.descriptionEn:
It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and
one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these
pads radiate tremendous heat.
details.descriptionKr:
싸울 준비가 되면
코끝과 발바닥의
볼록살에서 고열을 낸다.
details.descriptionJp:
たたかう　じゅんびが　ととのうと
はなの　あたまと　あしの　うらの
にくきゅうが　こうねつを　はっする。

details.descriptionEn:
The one with the best drumming techniques
becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle
disposition and values harmony among its group.
details.descriptionKr:
드럼 테크닉이 가장 뛰어난 자가
보스가 된다. 천성이 온화해서
그룹의 조화를 중히 여긴다.
details.descriptionJp:
ドラムテクニックに　すぐれた　ものが
ボスになる。　おだやかな　きしょうで
グループの　ちょうわを　おもんじる。

details.descriptionEn:
It kicks berries right off the branches of trees
and then juggles them with its feet, practicing
its footwork.
details.descriptionKr:
손을 쓰지 않고 나뭇가지에서
나무열매를 따내고 리프팅한다.
발 기술을 연마하는 연습이다.
details.descriptionJp:
てを　つかわずに　きの　えだから
きのみを　つみとり　リフティング。
あしわざを　みがく　れんしゅう。

details.descriptionEn:
When it gets wet, its skin changes color,
and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if
it were camouflaged.
details.descriptionKr:
젖으면 피부색이 변한다.
위장한 것처럼
모습이 보이지 않게 된다.
details.descriptionJp:
ひふの　いろは　ぬれると　かわる。
カモフラージュ　されたかの　ように
すがたが　みえなく　なるのだ。

details.descriptionEn:
It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it
gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts
showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
details.descriptionKr:
공수에 뛰어나고 응원을 받으면
더 뜨겁게 타오르지만 스탠드 플레이를
하다가 위기에 처하는 경우도 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
こうしゅに　すぐれ　おうえんされると
さらに　もえるが　スタンドプレイに
はしり　ピンチを　まねくこともある。
details.generaJp: ストライカーポケモン

details.descriptionEn:
Highly intelligent but also very lazy,
it keeps enemies out of its territory
by laying traps everywhere.
details.descriptionKr:
머리가 좋지만 귀찮음이 많다.
영역에 적이 다가오지 못하게
여기저기에 함정을 만들어 놓는다.
details.descriptionJp:
あたまが　よく　めんどうくさがり。
ナワバリに　てきが　ちかづかないよう
そこかしこに　ワナを　しかけている。

details.descriptionEn:
It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made
it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on
farms, searching for yet more berries.
details.descriptionKr:
항상 나무열매를 먹고 있어
보기보다 튼튼하다. 나무열매를
노리고 밭에 출몰한다.
details.descriptionJp:
つねに　きのみを　くっているので
みかけいじょうに　タフ。　きのみを
ねらって　はたけに　あらわれる。

details.descriptionEn:
Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’
weak points so it can precisely blast them with
water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
details.descriptionKr:
손가락 끝에서 마하3의 스피드로
물대포를 쏜다. 눈의 얇은 막으로
급소를 간파해 꿰뚫어버린다.
details.descriptionJp:
ゆびさきから　はなつ　みずでっぽうは
マッハ３の　はやさ。　しゅんまくで
きゅうしょを　みぬいて　うちぬくぞ。
details.generaJp: エージェントポケモン

details.descriptionEn:
Common throughout the Galar region, this
Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew
through the toughest of berry shells.
details.descriptionKr:
아무리 단단한 나무열매 껍질도
이빨로 아작아작 갉아 먹는다.
가라르에서 쉽게 볼 수 있는 포켓몬이다.
details.descriptionJp:
どんなに　かたい　きのみの　からも
じまんの　はで　ボリボリ　かじる。
ガラルでは　よく　みる　ポケモン。

details.descriptionEn:
The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it
how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.
details.descriptionKr:
혹독한 싸움을 헤쳐 나와
상대의 역량을 정확히
판단하는 힘을 습득했다.
details.descriptionJp:
きびしい　たたかいを　くぐりぬけて
あいての　りきりょうを　せいかくに
はんだんする　ちからが　みについた。

details.descriptionEn:
Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied
Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest
opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
details.descriptionKr:
작은 몸을 기민하게 날려
틈을 노리는 전법으로
몸집이 큰 상대를 농락한다.
details.descriptionJp:
ちいさい　からだで　きびんに　とんで
すきを　つく　せんぽうで　からだの
おおきな　あいてを　てだまにとる。

details.descriptionEn:
With their great intellect and flying skills, these
Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar
region’s airborne taxi service.
details.descriptionKr:
비행 능력이 뛰어나고
매우 영리해 가라르지방에서
하늘의 택시로 활약한다.
details.descriptionJp:
ひこう　のうりょくに　すぐれていて
とても　かしこいため　ガラルちほうで
そらの　タクシーとして　かつやく。

details.descriptionEn:
Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs
on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
details.descriptionKr:
밭에서 자주 보이는 포켓몬이다.
몸에 난 털로 주위에서
일어나는 일을 감지한다.
details.descriptionJp:
はたけで　よくみかける　ポケモン。
からだに　はえた　けで　まわりで
おきていることを　かんじとる。

details.descriptionEn:
As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic
abilities to monitor the outside world and
prepare for evolution.
details.descriptionKr:
껍질 안에서 성장 중이다.
사이코 파워로 밖의 상태를
살피며 진화에 대비하고 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
からの　なかで　せいちょうちゅう。
サイコパワーで　そとの　ようすを
うかがい　しんかに　そなえている。

details.descriptionEn:
It emits psychic energy to observe and study
what’s around it—and what’s around it can
include things over six miles away.
details.descriptionKr:
사이코 파워를 발산해 주위를
조사한다. 관측 범위는
주변 10km에 달한다.
details.descriptionJp:
サイコパワーを　はなち　しゅういを
しらべている。　かんそくはんいは
しゅうい　１０キロにも　たっするぞ。

details.descriptionEn:
Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by
stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with
swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
details.descriptionKr:
조심성이 많고 교활하다.
먹이를 훔치고는 꼬리로
발자국을 지우며 도망간다.
details.descriptionJp:
ようじん　ぶかく　ずるがしこい。
エサを　ぬすむと　しっぽで
あしあとを　けしながら　にげるのだ。

details.descriptionEn:
With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes
around stealing food and eggs. Boltund
is its natural enemy.
details.descriptionKr:
가벼운 몸과 날카로운 발톱으로
먹이나 알을 훔치며 돌아다닌다.
펄스멍이 천적이다.
details.descriptionJp:
みがるな　からだと　するどい　ツメで
エサや　タマゴを　ぬすんで　まわる。
パルスワンが　てんてき。

details.descriptionEn:
The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be
spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar
regional specialty.
details.descriptionKr:
머리의 솜털로 만든 실은
윤이 나고 매우 아름답다.
가라르지방의 특산품이다.
details.descriptionJp:
あたまの　わたげで　つくった　いとは
こうたくがあり　とても　うつくしい。
ガラルちほうの　めいさんひん。

details.descriptionEn:
It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous
song. This delightful display has charmed many
into raising this Pokémon.
details.descriptionKr:
산들바람에 빙글빙글 돌면서
즐겁게 노래하는 귀여운 모습에
반해서 키우는 사람이 많다.
details.descriptionJp:
そよかぜで　くるくる　まわりながら
たのしそうに　うたう　あいらしさに
みせられ　そだてる　ひとが　おおい。

details.descriptionEn:
If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be
able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this
Pokémon is surprisingly strong.
details.descriptionKr:
털이 많이 자라면 움직이지 못한다.
우르의 털로 짠 천은
놀라울 정도로 튼튼하다.
details.descriptionJp:
けが　のびすぎると　うごけない。
ウールーの　たいもうで　おられた
ぬのは　おどろくほど　じょうぶ。

details.descriptionEn:
This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck
to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and
take them down.
details.descriptionKr:
목을 자유자재로 늘이고 줄인다.
떨어져 있는 곳에서 목을 단번에 늘여
날카로운 이빨로 적의 숨통을 끊는다.
details.descriptionJp:
くびが　のびちぢみする。　はなれた
ところから　くびを　いっきに　のばし
するどい　キバで　てきを　しとめる。

details.descriptionEn:
Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the
opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
details.descriptionKr:
늠름하게 자란 뿔은 이성에게
어필하기 위한 것이다.
무기로는 사용하지 않는다.
details.descriptionJp:
りっぱに　のびた　ツノは　いせいに
アピールするために　はえている。
ぶきとして　つかうことはない。

details.descriptionEn:
It sends electricity through its legs to boost their
strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks
50 mph.
details.descriptionKr:
전기의 힘으로 다릿심을
강하게 키운다. 최고 속도는
시속 90km를 가볍게 넘긴다.
details.descriptionJp:
でんきの　ちからで　きゃくりょくを
ぞうきょう。　トップスピードは
じそく　９０キロを　かるく　こえる。

details.descriptionEn:
It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard
horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this
Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
details.descriptionKr:
머리 뿔은 바위처럼 단단하다.
뿔로 싸우다가 풀이 죽은 틈에
덥석 물고 놓지 않는다.
details.descriptionJp:
あたまの　ツノは　いわの　かたさ。
ツノで　たたかい　ひるんだ　すきに
パクリと　かみつき　はなさない。

details.descriptionEn:
This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with
their work because it wants treats. As it runs,
it crackles with electricity.
details.descriptionKr:
간식에 끌려 사람의 일을
돕는 먹보다. 탁탁 튀는
전기를 두르고 계속 달린다.
details.descriptionJp:
おやつに　つられて　ひとの　しごとを
てつだう　くいしんぼう。　パチパチと
でんきを　まとって　ひたはしる。

details.descriptionEn:
As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not
only does the apple serve as its food source, but
the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
details.descriptionKr:
태어나면 사과 안으로 숨어든다.
안을 파먹으면서 성장하고
사과 맛이 진화를 결정한다.
details.descriptionJp:
うまれると　りんごに　もぐりこむ。
なかみを　たべながら　せいちょうし
りんごの　あじが　しんかを　きめる。
details.generaJp: りんごぐらしポケモン

details.descriptionEn:
While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal
will burn bright red, sending off sparks that
scorch the surrounding area.
details.descriptionKr:
싸우게 되면 석탄으로 된 산이
새빨갛게 타올라 불똥을
흩뿌려 주위를 태운다.
details.descriptionJp:
たたかいになると　せきたんの　やまが
まっかに　もえあがり　ひのこを
まきちらして　しゅういを　こがす。

details.descriptionEn:
It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy
is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
details.descriptionKr:
콧구멍으로 모래를 분사한다.
적의 눈을 속이고 그 틈에
땅속으로 숨어들어 몸을 숨긴다.
details.descriptionJp:
はなの　あなから　すなを　ふんしゃ。
てきの　めを　くらました　すきに
ちちゅうに　もぐって　みを　かくす。

details.descriptionEn:
Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand
out of its sand sac more efficiently.
details.descriptionKr:
독특한 똬리 형태는
모래주머니의 모래를 더 효율적으로
분사하기 위함이다.
details.descriptionJp:
どくとくの　とぐろの　まきかたは
すなぶくろの　すなを　より　こうりつ
よく　ふんしゃ　するため　なのだ。

details.descriptionEn:
It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a
powerful acid. It can also change its shape
into that of an apple.
details.descriptionKr:
사과 껍질로 된 날개로 날며
강산성의 타액을 뱉는다.
사과의 형태로 변형한다.
details.descriptionJp:
りんごの　かわの　つばさで　とんで
きょうさんせいの　だえきを　とばす。
りんごの　かたちに　へんけいする。

details.descriptionEn:
After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become
extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant
swallows it up.
details.descriptionKr:
배가 불러서 현저히
움직임이 둔해지면
윽우지가 통째로 삼켜버린다.
details.descriptionJp:
はらいっぱいで　きょくたんに
うごきが　にぶった　ところを
ウッウに　まるのみに　される。

details.descriptionEn:
It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging
forward at speeds of over 100 knots before
ramming prey and spearing into them.
details.descriptionKr:
꼬리지느러미를 회전시켜 단번에
돌격한다. 100노트를 넘는
속도로 먹이를 관통한다.
details.descriptionJp:
おびれを　かいてんさせ　いっきに
とつげき。　１００ノットを　こえる
そくどで　えものを　つらぬくぞ。

details.descriptionEn:
This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole.
Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to
swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
details.descriptionKr:
먹보이다. 먹이인 찌로꼬치를
통째로 삼키지만 가끔 실수로
다른 포켓몬을 먹어버린다.
details.descriptionJp:
くいしんぼうで　エサの　サシカマスを
まるのみするが　たまに　まちがえて
ほかの　ポケモンに　くらいつく。

details.descriptionEn:
It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison
to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it
can cause a tingling paralysis.
details.descriptionKr:
독소를 화학 변화시켜
전기를 만들어 낸다. 전력은
약하지만 찌릿찌릿 마비된다.
details.descriptionJp:
どくそを　かがくへんか　させて
でんきを　だす。　でんりょくは
よわいが　ビリビリと　しびれる。

details.descriptionEn:
It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough,
rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
details.descriptionKr:
바위투성이의 거친 길을 아무렇지도
않게 일륜차처럼 달린다.
석탄을 태워서 살고 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
いわだらけの　あくろを　ものともせず
いちりんしゃのように　はしりまわる。
せきたんを　もやして　いきている。

details.descriptionEn:
Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed
when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back.
It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.
details.descriptionKr:
세 살 아이 정도의 지능을 가졌다.
촉수는 잘 끊어지지만
재생되기 때문에 신경 쓰지 않는다.
details.descriptionJp:
３さいじ　くらいの　かしこさ。
しょくしゅは　よくちぎれるが
さいせいするので　きにしない。

details.descriptionEn:
It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking
them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will
voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
details.descriptionKr:
발열된 몸으로 먹이를
세게 조른다. 알맞게 구워지면
우적우적 먹어버린다.
details.descriptionJp:
はつねつした　からだで　えものを
しめあげる。　こんがり　やけたら
むしゃむしゃ　いただくのだ。

details.descriptionEn:
While its burning body is already dangerous on
its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has
large and very sharp fangs.
details.descriptionKr:
공격적인 성질을 가졌다.
탄 몸도 위험하지만
큰 이빨도 날카롭다.
details.descriptionJp:
こうげきてきな　せいしつ。
やけた　からだも　きけんだが
おおきな　キバも　するどいぞ。

details.descriptionEn:
Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the
skin on its back is especially yummy. Children
used to have it as a snack.
details.descriptionKr:
달콤한 꿀로 몸이 둘러싸여 있다.
등의 껍질은 특히 더 달콤해서
옛날에는 어린이 간식이었다.
details.descriptionJp:
あまい　みつで　からだが　おおわれ
せなかの　かわは　とくに　あまく
むかしは　こどもの　おやつだった。

details.descriptionEn:
This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon
chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it
might contain.
details.descriptionKr:
호전적이며 성미가 급하다.
고인 물을 벌컥벌컥 마셔서
물속의 독소를 흡수한다.
details.descriptionJp:
ケンカごしで　きが　みじかい。
よどんだ　みずを　ガブのみして
すいちゅうの　どくそを　とりこむ。

details.descriptionEn:
The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its
home is a famous piece of antique tableware.
Many forgeries are in circulation.
details.descriptionKr:
거처로 삼고 있는 찻잔은
유명한 골동품 식기다.
위작이 많이 나돌고 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
すみかに　している　ティーカップは
ゆうめいな　アンティークの　しょっき。
おおくの　がんさくが　でまわっている。

details.descriptionEn:
Searching for an opponent to test its skills
against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle
is over, it returns to the sea.
details.descriptionKr:
자신의 실력을 시험하기 위해
육지로 올라가 대전 상대를 찾는다.
싸움이 끝나면 바다로 돌아간다.
details.descriptionJp:
おのれのうでを　ためすべく　りくに
あがり　たいせんあいてを　さがす。
たたかいおえると　うみに　かえる。
details.generaJp: じゅうじゅつポケモン

details.descriptionEn:
Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking
for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself
into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
details.descriptionKr:
남겨진 홍차를 발견하면
자신의 몸을 흘러 들어가게 한다.
그 홍차는 포트데스가 된다.
details.descriptionJp:
のこされた　こうちゃを　みかけると
じぶんの　からだを　そそぎこむ。
その　こうちゃは　ポットデスになる。

details.descriptionEn:
It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things
and feasting on the negative energy of the
frustrated occupants.
details.descriptionKr:
민가에 숨어들어 도둑질을
하고 속상해하는 사람의
마이너스 에너지도 얻는다.
details.descriptionJp:
みんかに　しのびこみ　ぬすみを
はたらき　さらに　くやしがる　ひとの
マイナスエネルギーも　いただくのだ。

details.descriptionEn:
If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it
will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas
without people.
details.descriptionKr:
인적이 드문 곳을 좋아한다.
강한 감정이 느껴지면
쏜살같이 도망쳐버린다.
details.descriptionJp:
ひとけの　ない　ばしょが　すき。
つよい　かんじょうを　かんじとると
いちもくさんに　にげだしてしまう。

details.descriptionEn:
Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to
get them to quiet down. One blow from those
braids would knock out a professional boxer.
details.descriptionKr:
머리의 술로 상대를 때려
꼼짝 못 하게 한다. 프로복서조차
한 방에 KO되는 파괴력이다.
details.descriptionJp:
あたまのフサで　あいてを　なぐり
だまらせる。　プロボクサーさえ
いっぱつ　ＫＯの　はかいりょく。

details.descriptionEn:
By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over
18 mph. The temperature of the flames it
breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
details.descriptionKr:
다리를 고속으로 회전시켜
시속 30km로 달린다.
섭씨 1000도의 불꽃을 내뿜는다.
details.descriptionJp:
あしを　こうそくで　かいてんさせて
じそく３０キロで　はしる。　せっし
１０００どの　ほのおを　ふきだす。

details.descriptionEn:
After many battles, it evolved dangerous
claws that come together to form daggers
when extended.
details.descriptionKr:
싸움에 열중해 진화한 결과
펴면 단검으로 변하는
위험한 발톱을 얻었다.
details.descriptionJp:
たたかいに　あけくれて　しんかした
けっか　のばすと　たんけんに　かわる
ぶっそうな　ツメを　てにいれた。

details.descriptionEn:
If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn
apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon
is also known as the Forest Witch.
details.descriptionKr:
숲의 마녀라는 별명을 가졌다.
소란을 피우면 촉수의 손톱에
찢겨질지도 모른다.
details.descriptionJp:
べつめいは　もりの　まじょ。
さわぎたてると　しょくしゅのツメで
ひきさかれるかも　しれないぞ。

details.descriptionEn:
With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the
woods. Some believe it to have the power to
make crops grow.
details.descriptionKr:
못된 꾀를 내어 밤에 숲으로
꾀어내려 한다. 농작물을
키우는 힘을 갖고 있는 듯하다.
details.descriptionJp:
わるぢえを　つかって　よるの　もりに
さそいこもうとする。　のうさくもつを
そだてる　ちからを　もつらしい。

details.descriptionEn:
It evolved after experiencing numerous fights.
While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that
would make any opponent flinch.
details.descriptionKr:
싸움을 반복하면서 진화한다.
팔을 크로스하고 우렁차게 외치면
어떤 상대라도 풀죽게 된다.
details.descriptionJp:
ケンカを　くりかえし　しんか。
うでをクロスし　さけぶ　おたけびは
どんな　あいても　ひるませるぞ。

details.descriptionEn:
Its amusing movements make it very popular.
It releases its psychic power from the pattern
on its belly.
details.descriptionKr:
유머러스한 움직임으로 모두에게
인기가 높다. 배의 무늬에서
사이코 파워를 방출한다.
details.descriptionJp:
ユーモラスな　うごきで　みんなの
にんきもの。　おなかの　もようから
サイコパワーを　ほうしゅつする。
details.generaJp: コメディアンポケモン

details.descriptionEn:
Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body
surrounding its soul. You’ll become
stiff as stone if you touch it.
details.descriptionKr:
영력이 높아져서 껍질에서
해방되었다. 영체로
핵이 되는 영혼을 지킨다.
details.descriptionJp:
たましいを　おおう　れいたいの
からだには　ちゅうい。　ふれると
いしのように　うごけなく　なるぞ。

details.descriptionEn:
After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield,
it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek
stalk is both weapon and food.
details.descriptionKr:
단단한 파잎으로 공격을 받아넘기고
날카로운 줄기로 반격한다.
파는 무기인 동시에 식재료다.
details.descriptionJp:
かたいネギの　はで　こうげきを
いなし　するどい　クキで　はんげき。
ネギは　ぶぐで　あり　しょくざい。

details.descriptionEn:
Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs
unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring
them as tentacles would.
details.descriptionKr:
머리카락은 근섬유의 역할을 하며
매듭이 풀어지면 촉수와 같은
움직임으로 상대를 묶어버린다.
details.descriptionJp:
かみのけは　きんにくせんいの　ように
はたらき　ほどけると　しょくしゅの
うごきで　あいてを　からめとる。
details.generaJp: ビルドアップポケモン

details.descriptionEn:
They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery
is guaranteed success and good fortune.
details.descriptionKr:
마빌크가 모습을 보인
디저트 가게는 크게
번창한다고 전해지고 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
マホミルが　すがたを　みせた
パティスリーは　だいはんじょうが
やくそく　されると　いわれている。

details.descriptionEn:
Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be
shown the horrific memories behind the picture
carved into it.
details.descriptionKr:
그림자 같은 몸을 만지면 안 된다.
그림에 새겨진 무서운 기억을
보게 되기 때문이다.
details.descriptionJp:
かげの　ような　からだに　ふれては
いけない。　えに　きざまれた
おそろしい　きおくを　みせられるぞ。

details.descriptionEn:
It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets
broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for
at least three hours.
details.descriptionKr:
가시 하나하나에 전기를
비축하고 있다. 부러진 가시도
3시간 동안 방전을 계속한다.
details.descriptionJp:
トゲの　１ぽん　１ぽんに　でんきを
たくわえる。　おれた　トゲでも
３じかんは　ほうでんを　つづけるぞ。

details.descriptionEn:
It eats snow that piles up on the ground.
The more snow it eats, the bigger and more
impressive the spikes on its back grow.
details.descriptionKr:
땅에 쌓인 눈을 먹는다.
많이 먹으면 먹을수록
등의 가시는 훌륭하게 자란다.
details.descriptionJp:
じめんに　つもった　ゆきを　たべる。
たくさん　たべれば　たべるほど
せなかの　トゲは　りっぱに　そだつ。

details.descriptionEn:
It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields
and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings,
causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
details.descriptionKr:
산과 들을 황폐하게 만들면 용서하지 않는다.
차가운 날개로 날아다니며
눈보라를 일으켜 응징한다.
details.descriptionJp:
のやまを　あらすものには　ようしゃ
しない。　つめたいはねで　とびまわり
ふぶきを　おこして　こらしめる。

details.descriptionEn:
Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific
time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in
a circle.
details.descriptionKr:
1년에 1번 정해진 일시에
어디선가 모여 둥글게
늘어서는 습성이 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
１ねんに　いちど　きまった　にちじに
どこから　ともなく　あつまり　わに
なって　ならぶ　しゅうせいが　ある。

details.descriptionEn:
This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool
with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single
hair into the sea to lure in prey.
details.descriptionKr:
더위에 약해서 얼굴을 언제나
얼음으로 식히고 있다. 머리의 털을
바다에 늘어뜨리고 먹이를 낚는다.
details.descriptionJp:
あつさに　よわい　かおを　いつも
こおりで　ひやしている。　あたまの
けを　うみに　たらして　エサをつる。

details.descriptionEn:
It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if
they’re precious treasures. No matter how much
it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
details.descriptionKr:
아무리 먹어도 금방 배가 고프다.
전기로 구운 씨앗을
소중히 갖고 다닌다.
details.descriptionJp:
どんなに　たべても　すぐに　おなかが
すく。　でんきで　ローストした
タネを　たいせつに　もちあるく。

details.descriptionEn:
Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions
of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the
source of its strength.
details.descriptionKr:
뿔로 가까이 있는 생명체의
기분을 읽는다. 긍정적인
감정이 힘의 원천이다.
details.descriptionJp:
ツノで　ちかくの　いきものの
きもちを　かんじとる。　ポジティブな
かんじょうが　ちからの　みなもと。

details.descriptionEn:
If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon
will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the
rain, turning a vibrant green color.
details.descriptionKr:
힘쓰는 일에 강하다.
동으로 된 몸체는 비에 녹슬어
선명한 녹색으로 변한다.
details.descriptionJp:
ちからしごとなら　おまかせ。
どうの　からだは　あめで　さび
あざやかな　みどりに　かわる。

details.descriptionEn:
These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have
incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush
giant rocks into powder.
details.descriptionKr:
무리를 지어 생활한다.
코의 악력은 큰 바위도
산산이 부술 정도로 강하다.
details.descriptionJp:
むれを　つくって　くらしている。
はなの　あくりょくは　おおいわも
こなごなに　くだくほど　つよい。

details.descriptionEn:
This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and
was able to preserve food with the ice on its
body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
details.descriptionKr:
고대의 해변에 살며 먹이를
몸의 얼음으로 보존시켰지만
움직임이 둔해 멸종하였다.
details.descriptionJp:
こだいの　うみべで　くらし　エサを
からだの　こおりで　ほぞん　できたが
うごきが　にぶいため　ぜつめつした。

details.descriptionEn:
When Alcremie is content, the cream it
secretes from its hands becomes sweeter
and richer.
details.descriptionKr:
손에서 나오는 크림은
마휘핑이 행복할 때
단맛과 감칠맛이 깊어진다.
details.descriptionJp:
てから　うみだす　クリームは
マホイップが　しあわせなとき
あまみと　コクが　ふかまる。

details.descriptionEn:
The powerful muscles in its tail generate its
electricity. Compared to its lower body,
its upper half is entirely too small.
details.descriptionKr:
꼬리의 억센 근육으로
발전한다. 하반신에 비해
상반신이 너무 작다.
details.descriptionJp:
しっぽの　たくましい　きんにくで
はつでんする。　かはんしんに　くらべ
じょうはんしんが　ちいさすぎる。

details.descriptionEn:
Its mighty legs are capable of running at
speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon
can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
details.descriptionKr:
특유의 다릿심으로 시속 60km
이상으로 달릴 수 있지만
물속에서만 호흡할 수 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
じそく６０キロを　こえる　じまんの
きゃくりょくで　はしれるが
すいちゅうでしか　こきゅうできない。

details.descriptionEn:
The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but
breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go
extinct anyway.
details.descriptionKr:
어떤 공격에도 상처 입지 않는
얼굴 가죽을 가졌지만 호흡이
자유롭지 않았던 탓에 멸종하였다.
details.descriptionJp:
どんな　こうげきにも　きずつかない
つらのかわを　もつが　こきゅうが
ふじゆうだったため　ぜつめつした。

details.descriptionEn:
If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child
could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help
it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
details.descriptionKr:
1마리로는 아이에게도 질 정도로
힘이 약하지만 동료의 협력으로
단련하고 진화하면 강해진다.
details.descriptionJp:
１ぴきでは　こどもにも　まけるくらい
ひりきだが　なかまの　きょうりょくで
きたえられ　しんかして　つよくなる。

details.descriptionEn:
The special metal that composes its body is very
light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility.
It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
details.descriptionKr:
금속으로 된 특수한 몸은
가벼워서 몸놀림이 뛰어나다.
비를 싫어해 동굴에 산다.
details.descriptionJp:
とくしゅな　きんぞくの　からだは
かるく　みのこなしは　ばつぐん。
あめが　にがてで　どうくつに　すむ。

details.descriptionEn:
Without a Dreepy to place on its head and
care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute
any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
details.descriptionKr:
보살피는 드라꼰을 머리에
태우지 않으면 진정하지 못하고
다른 포켓몬을 태우려고 한다.
details.descriptionJp:
せわをする　ドラメシヤを　あたまに
のせていないと　おちつかないので
ほかの　ポケモンを　のせようとする。

details.descriptionEn:
This Pokémon has slumbered for many years.
Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others
say the two Pokémon are rivals.
details.descriptionKr:
오랜 세월 잠들어 있던
자마젠타의 형제자매 또는
라이벌로 불리는 포켓몬이다.
details.descriptionJp:
ながい　ねむりに　ついていた
ザマゼンタの　あね　とも
ライバルとも　いわれる　ポケモン。

details.descriptionEn:
This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of
a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot
that it ever existed.
details.descriptionKr:
석상 같은 모습으로
잊혀질 정도의 세월 동안
잠들어 있던 포켓몬이다.
details.descriptionJp:
せきぞうの　ような　すがたで
わすれさられるほどの　あいだ
ねむりに　ついていた　ポケモン。

details.descriptionEn:
It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years
ago. There seems to be a connection between
this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
details.descriptionKr:
2만 년 전에 떨어진 운석
안에 있었다. 다이맥스의
수수께끼와 관련이 있는 듯하다.
details.descriptionJp:
２まんねんまえに　おちた　いんせきの
なかに　いた。　ダイマックスの
なぞに　かんけいしている　らしい。

details.descriptionEn:
If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head,
its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up
from the depths of its belly.
details.descriptionKr:
머리의 하얗고 긴 털을
잡아당기면 기세가 고조되어
단전에서 파워가 끓어오른다.
details.descriptionJp:
あたまの　しろく　ながい　たいもうを
ひっぱると　きあいが　たかまり
たんでんから　パワーが　わきあがる。

details.descriptionEn:
Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they
become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants
of the forest grow.
details.descriptionKr:
몸에 난 덩굴이 끊어지면
토양에 영양분이 되어
숲의 식물들을 성장시킨다.
details.descriptionJp:
からだに　はえる　ツルは　ちぎれると
つちの　えいようぶんとなって　もりの
しょくぶつたちを　そだてるのだ。

details.descriptionEn:
Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s
horns eagerly look forward to being launched out
at Mach speeds.
details.descriptionKr:
뿔에 들어간 드라꼰은
마하의 속도로 날려지기를
기대하고 있는 것 같다.
details.descriptionJp:
ツノに　はいった　ドラメシヤは
マッハの　スピードで　とばされるのを
こころまちに　しているらしい。

details.descriptionEn:
Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this
Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs
and refining its moves.
details.descriptionKr:
먼 지방의 산악지대에 산다.
낭떠러지 절벽을 달리며
하체를 단련하고 기술을 연마한다.
details.descriptionJp:
とおい　ちほうの　さんがくちたいで
くらす。　だんがいぜっぺきを　はしり
あしこしを　きたえ　わざを　みがく。

details.descriptionEn:
Its entire body is made up of a single organ that
generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable
of creating all Galar’s electricity.
details.descriptionKr:
온몸이 전기 에너지를 만드는 기관이다.
가라르 전 지역에서 사용하는 양의
전기를 만들어 낼 수 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
ぜんしんが　でんきエネルギーを
つくる　きかん。　ガラルぜんどの
でんきを　つくりだすことができる。
details.generaJp: エレクトロンポケモン

details.descriptionEn:
The six of them work together as one Pokémon.
Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they
constantly change their formation as they fight.
details.descriptionKr:
6마리가 1마리의 포켓몬이다.
대열을 바꿔가며
팀워크로 싸운다.
details.descriptionJp:
６ぴきで　１ぴきの　ポケモン。
たいれつを　くみかえながら
チームワークで　たたかうのだ。

details.descriptionEn:
Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and
the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times
harder than diamond.
details.descriptionKr:
굉장한 괴력을 가졌다.
얼굴을 덮는 얼음 마스크는
다이아몬드보다 100배 단단하다.
details.descriptionJp:
すさまじい　かいりきの　もちぬし。
かおを　おおう　こおりの　マスクは
ダイヤモンドの　１００ばい　かたい。

details.descriptionEn:
As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs
the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves
silence and solitude.
details.descriptionKr:
어두운 밤을 달리며 잠든 자의
생명 에너지를 흡수한다.
고독과 정적을 좋아한다.
details.descriptionJp:
やみよを　かけぬけ　ねているものの
せいめいエネルギーを　すいとる。
こどくと　せいじゃくを　このむ。

details.descriptionEn:
Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled
over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to
cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
details.descriptionKr:
먼 옛날 가라르를 지배했던
전설의 왕. 마음을 치유하고
초목을 싹 트게 하는 능력이 있다.
details.descriptionJp:
おおむかしの　ガラルを　すべていた
でんせつの　おう。　こころを　いやし
くさきを　めぶかせる　ちからがある。

details.descriptionEn:
The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is
erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains
heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes
and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon
this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its
burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat
at will.

Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before
fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species
throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical
prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen
highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
details.generaJp: クライミングポケモン

details.descriptionEn:
Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the
nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter
comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love
gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

Its body is composed of crystallized dragon
energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of
every dragon Pokémon.
details.descriptionKr:
온몸이 드래곤 에너지의
결정체다. 모든 드래곤포켓몬의
힘을 가지고 있는 듯하다.
details.descriptionJp:
ぜんしんが　ドラゴンエネルギーの
けっしょう。　すべての　ドラゴン
ポケモンの　ちからを　もつらしい。
details.generaJp: りゅうぎょくポケモン

details.descriptionEn: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.
Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.
The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.
The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.
This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.
It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.
Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.
Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.
The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.
It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.
The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.
Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.
The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.
The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.
The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.
It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.
This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.
This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.
Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.
The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.
It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.
It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.
Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.
Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.
It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.
details.generaJp: でんきおたまポケモン

details.descriptionEn: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.
What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.
details.generaJp: でんきがえるポケモン

details.descriptionEn: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.
It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.
details.generaJp: ぐんかんどりポケモン

details.descriptionEn: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.
To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.
Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.
Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.
Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.
details.generaJp: ころがりぐさポケモン

details.descriptionEn: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.
details.generaJp: ころがりぐさポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.
This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.
Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.
This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.
Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.
The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.
It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.
An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.
This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.
These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.
The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.
A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.
Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.
Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.
Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.
It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.
Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.
Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.
The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.
It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.
Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.
This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.
A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.
Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.
This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.
Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.
It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.
Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.
Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.
Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.
It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.
It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.
It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.
It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.
This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.
It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.
This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.
Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.
It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.
The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.
It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.
It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.
It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.
It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.
details.generaJp: ひょうりゅうポケモン

details.descriptionEn: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.
The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.
According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.
Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.
This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.
It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.
It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.
details.generaJp: りんごオロチポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン

details.descriptionEn: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.
It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.
details.generaJp: パラドックスポケモン
